items.title: Glossy Pop Newsletter: Social networking app Pie announces creator and founder Nadya Okamoto as chief marketing officer
items.summary: As the creator economy has grown, influencers and content creators have monetized their platforms. Nadya Okamoto (August brand founder) becomes CMO of Pie social app, signaling creator-led beauty brands and social commerce integration are accelerating.

items.title: Stripes Beauty expands to 448 Ulta stores as menopause care moves into the mainstream
items.summary: Stripes Beauty, focused on menopause skincare, expands from 4 to 448 Ulta locations. Menopause care is moving mainstream in North America, signaling strong retail demand for hormone-transition skincare.

items.title: Luxury Briefing: As luxury shoppers become more selective, couture is becoming a stronger VIC tool
items.summary: Luxury beauty shoppers more selective; VIC (Very Important Customer) programs driving loyalty. Premium skincare and niche fragrance gaining traction among high-value North American consumers.

items.title: Marketplace Briefing: AI traffic is poised to reshape the Amazon funnel
items.summary: AI-driven traffic (ChatGPT, Perplexity) is beginning to refer shoppers to Amazon product pages. Beauty brands need to optimize for AI discovery channels alongside traditional SEO.

items.title: Exclusive: Hung Vanngo Beauty is rethinking shade-matching with first foundation launch
items.summary: Celebrity makeup artist Hung Vanngo launches first foundation that reimagines shade-matching beyond traditional warm/neutral/cool undertones. Inclusive shade matching is a hot trend in North American complexion makeup.

items.title: Physicians Formula returns to '2016 makeup' with Jaclyn Hill and Manny MUA partnership
items.summary: Physicians Formula celebrates Butter Bronzer's 10th anniversary with Jaclyn Hill & Manny MUA. Nostalgia-driven beauty campaigns and OG influencer collaborations are driving engagement among millennials in North America.

items.title: Wellness Briefing: How brands are leveraging grassroots social wellness meetups
items.summary: Beauty and wellness brands leveraging grassroots Gen Z/millennial social meetup groups (Coffee & Chill) for authentic community marketing. Social wellness and IRL events becoming key DTC acquisition channels in North America.

items.title: North America skincare bestsellers 2026: Retinol, SPF, barrier repair trending on Amazon & Sephora
items.summary: Based on news signals and beauty industry reports: Top North American skincare categories 2026 are retinol/vitamin A serums, SPF moisturizers, barrier repair (ceramide-based), niacinamide toners, and scalp/hair-wellness crossover products. Key brands: CeraVe, The Ordinary, La Roche-Posay, Tatcha, Charlotte Tilbury.
